caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted rooster standing atop a green barrel, which is mounted vertically on a post. The rooster is colored primarily in shades of brown and gold, with greenish highlights on its detailed feathers, and features a red comb and wattle. The barrel has metallic-looking green bands around it, with yellow visible at its circular ends. The composition is supported by a vertical rod that passes through the barrel and up behind the rooster, ending in a pointed tip above the rooster’s back. The base of the post consists of a round, stone-like sphere placed on a stepped square plinth with a block-like bottom, giving the whole arrangement a pedestal appearance. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and the artist's signature is visible in small red letters near the lower left of the object.
title: Weather Vane
